description: This file defines strategies for tensor operations, particularly focusing on einsum-based strategies in distributed tensor computations within the PyTorch framework. It includes data classes for parsing einsum equations and generating device mesh strategies for distributed computation.

classes.name: EinsumDims
classes.description: Data class for parsing and holding the dimensions involved in an einsum operation, including methods for parsing einstein summation equations and extracting contraction, batch, and free dimensions.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],str] parse_equation(cls, equation: str)
methods.description: Parses an einsum equation string into input dimension lists and output dimension string.

methods.name: "EinsumDims" parse_dims(cls, input_dims: list[str], output_dim: str)
methods.description: Analyzes input dimensions and output dimension string to classify dimensions into contraction, batch, and free dims.

methods.name: OpStrategy gen_einsum_strategies( equation: str, mesh: DeviceMesh, *, linearity: bool = False, )
methods.description: Generates a list of distributed tensor strategies for an einsum operation over a device mesh, considering different sharding and partial strategies based on the einsum equation.
